description_en: Connects an on-premises network to a cloud service
description_zh: 您可以通过调用ResolveAndRouteServiceInCen接口设置云服务，为本地网络添加访问云服务的配置
kebab_example: aliyun cbn resolve-and-route-service-in-cen --client-token 02fb3da40000 --cen-id cen-ckwa2hhmuislse0000 --host 100.118.28.0/24 --host-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-vpc-id vpc-o6woh5s494zueq40v0000 --description descname --access-region-ids cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResolveAndRouteServiceInCen

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not set this parameter, ClientToken is set to the value of RequestId. The value of RequestId for each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses or CIDR blocks of the cloud service.

In most cases, multiple IP addresses or CIDR blocks are assigned to a cloud service. We recommend that you call this operation multiple times to add all IP addresses and CIDR blocks of the cloud service
parameters.help_zh:
云服务IP地址或地址段。

通常云服务会使用多个地址或地址段，建议您重复调用本接口，添加该云服务所有地址或地址段
parameters.name: host

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the cloud service is deployed
parameters.name: host_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC that is associated with the cloud service
parameters.name: host_vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the cloud service.

This parameter is optional. If you enter a description, it must be 1 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http\:// or https\://
parameters.help_zh:
云服务的描述信息。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the regions where the cloud service is accessed
parameters.help_zh: 访问云服务的地域ID列表
parameters.name: access_region_ids
